name: sit-show-hand
description: The wolf shows his hand while seated. SpeAction/sit show hand is derived from ProAction/Take a seat record 4 (the seated body) plus the right-arm gesture of SpeAction/say hello records 2-4 (rShoulder 100, rArm 15/5/15, rHand 70); only the right arm moves, every record re-sends the seated frame, and the head stays centred. Built by build/sit/build_show_hand.py. SAFETY: record 4 is a transient frame, not a rest pose, so this sequence must stay short and autoStand must stay on. The move has not been watched on hardware and its clock is unknown; do not put it in a timed story until it has been measured. Copy build/sit/final/*.sh to D:\SpeAction first.
